items.title: The derived tensor product with a fixed complex is left adjoint to the derived Hom
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dga.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-tensor-with-complex-hom-adjoint at source lines 6276-6293: for a ringed site and a complex of O-modules K^bullet, the left derived functor - tensor^L_E K^bullet of the earlier lemma is a left adjoint of the derived Hom R Hom(K^bullet, -) of the earlier existence lemma. The proof at source lines 6295-6336 unwinds the adjunction into a bifunctorial isomorphism of Hom-groups and then has to justify two replacements (M by a dg E-module P with property (P), L^bullet by a K-injective complex), translate the two derived functors into morphisms in the homotopy categories by the author's derived-Hom computation, and reduce the resulting graded statement along the property-(P) filtration to the case where P is a graded projective E-module, where the isomorphism is visible on P = E[k] and compatible with differentials. None of the individual steps is deep, but the card's substance is knowing which replacements are legitimate in the derived category and why the filtration reduction is allowed, and the statement itself lists only the adjunction.
